h1: Best Zero-Commission Teaching Platform in India (2026): What 0% Really Costs
dek: Several platforms publish a 0% fee on your sales, but every one of them charges a fixed fee instead. Here is what each costs upfront, when a percentage costs less, and where AllCoaching's own 0% plans fit.
cover_alt: Is zero commission really cheaper: 0% teaching platforms in India compared with prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026
audience: Independent educators and coaching institutes in India comparing zero-commission and percentage-fee teaching platforms
intro: The teaching platforms that publish a 0% fee on your sales in 2026 all charge a fixed fee instead: Learnyst from ₹8,099 a month billed annually (₹97,188 a year), AllCoaching's monthly plans from ₹3,999 a month + GST (₹47,988 a year), TagMango Ultimate at ₹30,000 a month + GST, and Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable's paid plans in US dollars. Zero commission is cheaper only once your sales are high enough to cover that fixed fee.

We are AllCoaching, so read our entry with that in mind. Our monthly plans take 0% commission, so you keep 100% of every sale: Starter ₹3,999, Growth ₹5,999 and Pro ₹7,999 a month (Pro adds the iOS app, 4K video and 2 TB of storage), plus GST, with no sales limit and no lock-in. Our yearly plans charge less upfront (₹6,999, ₹12,999 or ₹24,999 a year) plus a 10%, 7.5% or 5% platform fee; yearly Starter costs less than any 0% plan here until you sell about ₹4 lakh a year.

Every competitor price below comes from that company's own pricing page, linked and dated (24 Oct 2026). Dollar prices are shown as published and exclude Indian GST. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.
takeaways: No 0% plan is free. Each platform that publishes a 0% fee on sales charges a fixed monthly or yearly price for that plan.

AllCoaching's monthly plans are zero commission: Starter ₹3,999 a month + GST with your own website and Android app, Growth ₹5,999, and Pro ₹7,999 a month adding the iOS app; no sales limit, and you keep 100% of every sale.
Learnyst's 0% plans start at ₹8,999 a month (₹8,099 billed annually, ₹97,188 a year), taxes extra; its Launcher plan takes 10%.
TagMango Ultimate is zero commission at ₹30,000 a month + GST, with a payment-gateway charge from 1.9%.
Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable's Builder and Growth plans publish 0% platform fees in US dollars; payment-processing fees still apply.
Below about ₹4 lakh of sales a year, a percentage costs less than any 0% plan here, for example AllCoaching's yearly Starter (₹6,999 a year + 10%), on published prices.
If you want nothing upfront at all, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic charge no fixed fee but take 10% commission; custom website and app are paid add-ons.

sections.h2: The short answer: zero commission means a fixed fee instead
sections.html:
The best zero-commission platform depends on your sales. A 0% plan suits an educator whose yearly sales are large enough that a fixed fee costs less than a percentage. Below that level, a low fixed price with a percentage usually costs less.

{{fig:verdict|Which platform fits by sales and goal: 0% built around DRM test series, Learnyst Professional; 0% with your own website and apps, AllCoaching monthly plans from ₹3,999 a month; selling in dollars, Kajabi, Thinkific or Teachable; below about ₹4 lakh a year, AllCoaching's yearly Starter with a 10% fee|Pick the row that sounds like you. The rest of this guide shows the numbers.}}

The cost section below shows where each line crosses, using only published prices.

We looked for platforms whose official pricing page publishes a 0% fee on sales, and added the lowest-commission plan from Exly for comparison. For each we recorded four things.

  1. The fixed price of the 0% plan, monthly and billed annually, from the official page.
  2. Other charges the page states, such as payment-gateway or processing fees and paid add-ons.
  3. Currency and tax: rupees or US dollars, and whether GST or taxes are extra.
  4. What is included: custom domain and branded app, or add-ons.

We left out platforms whose pages do not state a fee on sales either way. Classplus and Edmingle state no fee, so we cannot call them zero-commission. Graphy's US page shows a 0% transaction fee, but its prices are shown by country and we could not confirm the Indian rupee plans on 24 Oct 2026; check graphy.com/pricing from India.[8]

Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide and sells some of the 0% plans listed (its monthly plans), so we list it last and show the same facts for it as for every other platform. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in.

Zero commission means the platform takes no percentage of your sales; it does not mean the platform is free. Every 0% plan in this guide has a fixed monthly or yearly price, and most still pass on payment-gateway or card-processing charges.

1. You pay before your first sale

A fixed fee is due whether you sell or not. AllCoaching's 0% plans are ₹3,999, ₹5,999 or ₹7,999 a month plus GST, billed monthly with no lock-in; Learnyst's Professional plan is ₹97,188 a year billed annually; and TagMango Ultimate is ₹3,60,000 a year plus GST. For a new educator, even a monthly fee is a cost to carry before students arrive.

2. Payment charges still apply

Kajabi says card processing fees apply, Thinkific prices its payments at 2.9% in line with Stripe and PayPal, Teachable marks its 0% with processing fees, and TagMango lists a gateway charge from 1.9%. Compare these separately from the platform fee.

{{q:Is a zero-commission platform cheaper than one that takes a percentage?|Only above a certain sales level. Below it, the fixed fee of a 0% plan costs more than a percentage of your sales. Divide the 0% plan's yearly price by the percentage you would otherwise pay to find roughly where they cross, or use the table in the cost section.}}

3. Add-ons change the total

On some platforms your own domain and branded app are add-ons. Thinkific's branded app is $199 a month; TagMango's custom domain is ₹24,999 a year and its own-app setup ₹74,999 + GST. Add these before you compare.

{{fig:before-after|Questions to ask about a zero-commission plan: fee due before the first sale, gateway charges, billing in dollars, app or domain as add-ons; compared with AllCoaching's monthly plans from ₹3,999 a month with 0% commission and own domain and apps included|Whatever you choose, compare the full yearly cost at your real sales, not the headline percentage.}}

sections.h2: Teaching platforms with a 0% fee, and what they cost
sections.html:

1. Learnyst (Professional, Premium, Business)

Good at
Courses, mock tests and live classes with test series and branded apps; it offers the "Features required to market and sell your content online across globe".[1]
Published 0% plan
Professional ₹8,999/month (₹8,099/month billed annually) with 0% transaction fees; Premium ₹14,999/month (₹13,499 annually) and Business ₹49,999/month (₹44,999 annually) include everything in Professional; taxes extra.
Free trial
Not stated as a trial; buttons say "Get started for free".
Check
Its Launcher plan (₹10,000/yr) takes 10% of sales, so 0% applies only to the monthly plans. Apps are published under Learnyst's developer account; a branded Android app starts from Premium.
Best for
Indian exam academies with high, steady sales that want a 0% plan built around DRM-protected test series.

2. TagMango Ultimate

Check

Large coaching and community businesses with high, steady sales.

Courses, coaching, memberships, website, email and checkout; "One subscription runs your whole business, and Kajabi takes no revenue share."[3]

14 days; 30-day money-back guarantee.
Check

Best for

Check

5. Teachable (Builder and Growth)

sections.h2: Fixed fee vs percentage: which costs less at your sales
sections.html:
A fixed fee costs the same at every sales level; a percentage grows with your sales. The chart adds each published plan price to its published fee at five sales levels, using the lowest-cost plan each time, for the rupee-priced platforms.

{{fig:cost|Total yearly cost at ₹0 to ₹50 lakh of sales: AllCoaching's lowest-cost plan (a yearly plan at 10% to 5%, or Starter monthly at 0%) against Learnyst Professional at 0%, Exly Premium at 3% and TagMango Ultimate at 0%|Before GST and payment-gateway charges. Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable are left out because they are priced in US dollars.}} {{cost_table}}

The honest reading: up to about ₹4 lakh of sales a year, AllCoaching's yearly Starter at 10% costs less than any 0% plan here (from about ₹2.4 lakh, yearly Growth at 7.5% is lower still). Above about ₹4.7 lakh, AllCoaching Starter monthly at 0% commission is ₹47,988 a year (₹3,999 a month) with no sales limit, and Pro at ₹7,999 a month adds the iOS app, 4K video and more storage. On the other rupee-priced plans, Learnyst Professional is ₹97,188, Exly Premium ₹1,08,000 + 3% and TagMango Ultimate ₹3,60,000. Below about ₹4.8 lakh a year, Exly Starter and TagMango Basic cost less still, because they charge no fixed fee and the same 10% as AllCoaching Starter, though a custom website and app are paid add-ons there. These are our own prices set against our competitors', so check every source link.

So the trade-off is simple: a percentage lets you pay less while you are growing, and a 0% plan rewards you once sales are high and steady. Run your own numbers in the plan finder, and see how to price online courses in India.

{{cta}}

New educator (under ₹5 lakh a year)

A large fixed fee is the biggest risk. Choose a low fixed price or no fixed fee, and check what your own website and app cost on top. Our guide on selling courses without a monthly subscription covers this stage.

Growing academy (₹5 to 18 lakh a year)

Compare totals, not percentages. On published prices, AllCoaching Starter monthly at 0% commission (₹47,988 a year, no sales limit) costs less than the other 0% plans here across this range.

Large academy (above ₹18 lakh a year)

A 0% plan now costs less than a percentage. Compare the fixed price and what it includes: AllCoaching's monthly plans (₹3,999 or ₹5,999 a month) include your own website and Android app, and Pro (₹7,999 a month) adds the iOS app, on your own developer accounts, with no lock-in on monthly billing; Learnyst Professional (₹97,188 a year billed annually) suits DRM test series. Weigh whose developer account publishes your app.

Educator selling internationally

Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable are built for dollar sales. See our Kajabi alternative in India and Teachable and Thinkific alternative guides.

Any stage: check payments and tax

Gateway charges and GST apply on most platforms. See UPI payment gateways for online courses and GST and income tax for online tutors.

sections.h2: How to decide between a 0% plan and a percentage
sections.html:
The decision takes four steps and one honest sales estimate.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to decide between a zero-commission plan and a percentage fee: estimate your yearly sales, convert every fee to rupees, add gateway charges and add-ons, test in a trial|Use last year's sales if you have them, and a cautious estimate if you do not.}} {{steps}}

If you are already on another platform, see how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: Use last year's course sales, or a cautious estimate for the next 12 months.
Multiply each percentage by your sales and add the plan's yearly price; convert dollar plans at today's rate.
Include payment-processing fees, GST, and the cost of your own domain and branded app where they are add-ons.
Test the best fit in a free trial
Build one course and sell to a few real students before you commit to a yearly plan.

faq: What is the best zero-commission teaching platform in India?

It depends on your sales and currency. Among rupee-priced 0% plans we checked, AllCoaching's monthly plans start at ₹3,999 a month + GST (₹47,988 a year) with your own website and Android app included and no sales limit (we publish this guide), Learnyst's start at ₹8,099 a month billed annually (₹97,188 a year), and TagMango Ultimate is ₹30,000 a month plus GST. For dollar sales, Kajabi, Thinkific and Teachable publish 0% platform-fee plans.
No. Every platform in this guide that publishes a 0% fee on sales charges a fixed monthly or yearly price for that plan, and most still pass on payment-gateway or processing charges.

Only on the yearly plans: Starter ₹6,999 a year + 10%, Growth ₹12,999 + 7.5% and Pro ₹24,999 + 5% of sales. The monthly plans (₹3,999, ₹5,999 or ₹7,999 a month) take 0% commission, so you keep 100% of every sale. GST is extra and payment-gateway charges are separate.
When is a 0% plan cheaper than a percentage fee?

When your sales are high enough. On AllCoaching's own prices, yearly Starter (₹6,999 + 10%) costs less below about ₹4 lakh of sales a year; above that, a monthly plan at 0% commission (Starter ₹3,999 a month, ₹47,988 a year) usually leaves you more (illustrative, before GST and gateway charges). Learnyst's 0% Professional plan is ₹97,188 a year billed annually.
Do zero-commission platforms still charge payment fees?

Usually yes. Kajabi and Teachable mention processing fees, Thinkific prices its payments at 2.9%, TagMango lists a gateway charge from 1.9% on Ultimate, and on AllCoaching the payment-gateway charge is separate from the 0% commission on every monthly plan.
Is there a teaching platform with no upfront fee in India?
Yes. Exly Starter has no annual fee and TagMango Basic has no fixed fee, but both take 10% commission, and a custom website or branded app costs extra.
Only on its monthly plans. Professional, Premium and Business list 0% transaction fees; the Launcher plan at ₹10,000 a year takes 10% of sales. Taxes are extra on all plans.
Should a new educator choose a zero-commission platform?

Usually not at the start. A 0% plan's fixed fee is due before your first sale. A lower fixed price with a percentage costs less until your sales grow, and you can move to a 0% plan later if the numbers favour it.
glossary: A pricing model where the platform takes no percentage of your sales and charges a fixed monthly or yearly fee instead.
A percentage a platform keeps from each sale. AllCoaching's is 0% on every monthly plan, and 10%, 7.5% or 5% on the yearly plans, charged only when you sell.
The charge for processing a card or UPI payment, separate from any platform fee or commission.
The yearly sales level at which two pricing models cost the same; above it, the lower-percentage plan costs less.
A feature sold separately from the main plan, such as a branded app or custom domain.
